# Bathrooms.com

> > UK bathroom retailer offering contemporary suites, fixtures, and design advice from The Bathroom Showroom, featuring brands like Roca, Hansgrohe, and Durapanel.

Bathrooms.com provides comprehensive bathroom solutions including product ranges, buying guides, maintenance advice, and design inspiration. The site emphasizes water-saving technology, energy efficiency, and compliance with UK Building Regulations for ventilation and fixtures.

## Key Topics

- Roca bathroom suites
- The Bathroom Showroom
- Water-saving technology
- Bathroom ventilation (UK Building Regulations)
- Contemporary bathroom design
- Durapanel wall panels
- Chrome fixtures and finishes
- Energy efficiency
- Mould prevention
- Drain maintenance
- Extractor fans
- Bathroom furniture colours
- Hansgrohe collections
- Eco-friendly showers
- Indoor bathroom plants

## Bathroom Suites & Product Collections

- [Roca Adena Contemporary Bathroom Suite](https://www.bathrooms.com/suites/roca-adena): Roca Adena contemporary bathroom suite with rimless wall-hung toilet

- [Relax with the Hansgrohe Bathroom Collection](https://www.bathrooms.com/blogs/hansgrohe-bathroom-collection): Hansgrohe luxury German-engineered bathroom fixtures with water-saving tech
